verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own time-based Reminders feature and says Recipes let users set up automations, which together are a thin form of scheduled workflow. Nothing states that jobs can recur on a cadence or that automations run on a time trigger. API-triggered messages from CI/CD and monitoring tools are event-driven, not scheduled, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron-style scheduling of jobs or workflows, documentation of time-triggered recipes or automations, management of scheduled jobs (list/edit/pause), independent or hands-on corroboration.
